# Cortex Terminal

> Free, open-source Android terminal app that runs Ubuntu 24.04 LTS's own programs (glibc 2.39, apt) on unrooted devices through an LD_PRELOAD library, the technique of fakechroot and fakeroot, rewritten for Android. No ptrace (not PRoot), no virtual machine, no root. An alternative to Termux + proot-distro. Apache-2.0.

Cortex runs Ubuntu's unmodified binaries directly on the Android kernel. A preloaded library inside each program maps file paths such as /usr and /etc to the app's private storage, emulates root-only details such as the user id, and handles what Android's seccomp filter forbids; statically linked programs are patched once before their first start (static C/C++, Go 1.19+). Other users (su, runuser, PostgreSQL) are emulated for the programs, and ports below 1024 are moved 8000 up. Since 1.28.1 the terminal runs as an ordinary user (cortex) with sudo for root work. Not supported without root: systemd, mount, containers. Ubuntu 24.04 is built in and its packages come from Ubuntu's archive via apt. A setup on the first start can instead install Ubuntu 26.04, Debian 13, Kali, Arch Linux ARM, Fedora 44, openSUSE Tumbleweed or Void, downloaded from the project's GitHub releases and checked against their SHA-256. The cortex-api command gives programs Android features (notifications, clipboard, opening links and files in Android apps, sharing, battery state). On rooted phones an optional root mode runs sessions as real root in a chroot of the same Ubuntu. APKs exist for arm64-v8a and armeabi-v7a (Android 7.0+). The interface supports 50 languages. An optional X11 desktop (XFCE, LXQt, MATE, KDE Plasma or Openbox, and Firefox) can be installed from the app and is shown inside it; Xvnc runs on a private Unix socket. Drawing is done by the CPU unless the experimental GPU acceleration is on, which sends OpenGL through Mesa's virpipe driver to virglrenderer running on the phone's GPU. No Wayland.

## Links
- [Source code](https://github.com/ssfuisu/cortex): repository, issues and README
- [Latest APK](https://github.com/ssfuisu/cortex/releases/latest): Cortex-arm64-v8a-signed.apk and Cortex-armeabi-v7a-signed.apk
- [Website](https://ssfuisu.github.io/cortex/): overview, comparison with Termux and proot-distro, FAQ
- [Package compatibility](https://ssfuisu.github.io/cortex/compat.html): nightly results of installing and testing common packages
- [Security](https://github.com/ssfuisu/cortex/blob/main/SECURITY.md): sandbox, permissions, verifying a download
- [Containers](https://github.com/ssfuisu/cortex/blob/main/docs/containers.md): Podman and Docker in root mode
- [Telegram](https://t.me/ratzgn): contact the developer
